question: A circular park having a radius of 14 m. If a 1.5 m wide path is built around it, what is the approximate area of the path?
solution:
**Given:**

Radius of the circular park = 14 m

Width of the path = 1.5 m

**Formula Used:**

Area of the path = Area of the outer circle - Area of the inner circle

Area of a circle = π × r²

**Calculation:**

Radius of the outer circle = Radius of the park + Width of the path = 14 + 1.5 = 15.5 m

⇒ Area of the inner circle = π × 14² = 22/7 × 14 × 14 = 616 m²

⇒ Area of the outer circle = π × 15.5² = 22/7 × 15.5 × 15.5 = 754.38 m²

⇒ Area of the path = Area of the outer circle - Area of the inner circle

⇒ Area of the path = 754.38 - 616 = 138.38 m² ≈ 139 m²

**∴ The approximate area of the path is 139
 m².**
